title: Shopify store development from scratch
h1: Shopify store development, built from scratch
seoDescription: A complete Shopify store built in your own account: theme, products, payments and pages. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: We build a new Shopify store in your own Shopify account, from an empty start to ready for its first order. You get a private preview link, a launch checklist and a handover, so you know how to run the store.

title: Shopify store redesign for existing stores
h1: Shopify store redesign without losing your rankings
seoDescription: A fresh, faster look for your current Shopify store, with products, pages and search rankings kept. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: We redesign the Shopify store you already have, in a duplicate theme so your live shop keeps selling while we work. Products, collections, blog posts and web addresses stay as they are, so search rankings are not put at risk. You approve a private preview before anything goes live.

title: Shopify conversion rate optimization
h1: Shopify CRO to turn more visitors into buyers
seoDescription: Product page, cart and checkout improvements for your Shopify store, tracked so you can see the change. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: We study how shoppers move through your Shopify store, then fix what slows them down. We start with a review of your analytics, product pages, cart and checkout steps, and rank the changes by effort and likely payoff. Then we make the changes in a copy of your theme and track the result with your own analytics, so you can see what moved. You keep a plain-English report with the next steps.

title: Shopify SEO and speed optimization
h1: Shopify SEO and speed, so shoppers find you and stay
seoDescription: Faster pages and cleaner search settings for your Shopify store, with titles, images and structure fixed. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: We audit your Shopify store for the things that slow it down and hold back search visibility, then fix them in your account. That covers image sizes, unused apps and code, page titles and descriptions, product and collection structure, and the sitemap. You get a before and after speed check and a short written summary. We aim to make pages load faster and easier for search engines to read, and we do not promise rankings.

title: Shopify theme customization and edits
h1: Shopify theme edits, fixes and custom sections
seoDescription: Layout changes, bug fixes and new sections added to your current Shopify theme, tested on mobile. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: Send us a list of what you want changed in your current theme and we make the edits in a duplicate copy of it. That can be small layout and text fixes, a broken section, a new feature such as a size guide or announcement bar, or a custom section you can edit in the theme editor. We test every change on desktop and mobile, then publish when you approve.

title: Migrate to Shopify from any platform
h1: Shopify migration from WooCommerce, Wix and more
seoDescription: Move your store to Shopify with products, customers, orders and 301 redirects carried over. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
summary: We move your store from WooCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Magento, BigCommerce or another platform into your own Shopify account. We export your data, clean it up and import products, collections, customers and past orders. We then map every old web address to its new one with 301 redirects, so shoppers and search engines land on the right page. Your old store stays online until you are happy to switch.
